## Identity

## What he does
Bharat designs and builds intelligent, production-ready systems: GenAI and
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, GraphRAG and multi-agent
architectures, distributed backends and microservices, machine-learning and
computer-vision models, and modern full-stack web applications (including Web3).

## Notable projects
- GenAI Realtime Assistant — multi-agent assistant using GraphRAG, LangGraph, Neo4j, and FAISS for real-time contextual reasoning.
- Federated Learning for Anomaly Detection — privacy-preserving fraud detection achieving 91% accuracy with zero data sharing.
- DeepFake Detection System — CNN-based detector with 95% accuracy, enhanced by multi-criteria decision making (MCDM).
- AI-Driven Image Encryption — novel GAN-LSTM one-pass encryption pipeline.
- GigX — decentralized freelance marketplace with Ethereum smart-contract escrow.
- Book Detection for the Visually Impaired — real-time OCR-to-speech accessibility system.
